newsitem.title: CHINA: Shenzhen B shares close higher on SEG advance.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares close higher on SEG advance.

text.p: Shenzhen's hard currency B share index ended slightly firmer on Monday, buoyed by a strong rise in television tube maker Shenzhen SEG Co, brokers said.
The index inched up 0.03 point or 0.02 percent to 130.89 on turnover of HK$45 million against HK$63 million last Friday.
The domestic A share market gained 4.53 points or 1.11 percent to 413.99 on turnover of 5.2 billion yuan against 3.8 billion yuan in the previous session.
"SEG boosted the B share index," an analyst at J&A Securities (HK) said.
SEG posted the best B share performance as it surged HK$0.47 or 9.75 percent to HK$5.29 on volume of 2.1 million shares, making it the second most actively traded issue.
Analysts said some institutional buying supported the issue which was seen as rebounding from its recent falls.
Despite signs that interest in the market might be picking up, analysts said there were concerns over the medium-term outlook.
"I am not optimistic about the (B share) market," an analyst at China Guotai Securities said. "The market is short of positive news."
